The Trump administration has proposed imposing tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods following a Section 301 investigation into alleged excess manufacturing capacity in 14 economies. India has rejected the US claims, maintaining that no sector in the country has structurally excessive production capacity. With India and the US negotiating a bilateral trade agreement, the proposed tariffs could create fresh uncertainty for trade relations.
